about: The mutant ledger of internal/sizes: edits of the size receipt and its budget check that some internal/sizes test must kill. Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants ./internal/sizes (docs/tooling.md, "Mutant ledger"). Seeded by binsize BS0.

mutants.name: bs0-compare-off
mutants.rule: binsize plan 3 (f): a receipt whose Ergo-only bytes pass the fixture's ceiling fails the budget.

mutants.name: bs0-fact-off
mutants.rule: binsize plan 3 (f): a linked symbol that a fact forbids fails the budget.

mutants.name: bs0-wrong-file
mutants.rule: binsize plan 3 (f): the stripped size is the stripped file's size.

mutants.name: bs0-no-control
mutants.from: func (r Receipt) ErgoOnly() int64 { return r.Size - r.Control.Size }
mutants.to: func (r Receipt) ErgoOnly() int64 { return r.Size }
mutants.rule: binsize plan 3 (f): Ergo-only bytes are the fixture's size minus the Go hello control's.

mutants.name: bs8-fact-names-variant
mutants.rule: binsize BS8: the registry facts forbid the reference lowering's start-up registration, not the lazy variant read of a generic flat union's ErgoVariant.

mutants.name: bs8-fact-misses-register
mutants.rule: binsize BS7, BS8: an actor fixture that links the registry lowering's RegisterMachine breaks its fact.
